title: moderation.check_sanctions
description: Is this user under an active sanction? The READ half of enforcement (spec §9.4): the module answers, the host's own write view refuses — moderation does not intercept anybody's traffic. Response: {"allowed": boolean, "sanctions": [{"kind", "scope", "expires_at", "reason_code"}]}.

scope.description: Narrow the question to one scope: a sanction scoped "*" always matches, a scoped one matches only its own scope. Absent = ask about "*" only.
